final_message:
I added the three views to `notebooks/explore.py`, each in its own named cell. Before each view is a hypothesis cell, and after each is a facts cell with the numbers. The notebook passes `marimo check`, and an HTML export ran all three charts with no errors.

1. **`shipments_per_month`**: a line chart of shipments per month, Jan 2023 to Dec 2024.
   - 2023: April to June had 54, 55 and 50, in line with the other months (41 to 60).
   - 2024: April to June had 35, 41 and 39. The lowest month in the data is April 2024.
2. **`q2_dip_by_port`**: for each port, the change in shipments per month in Q2 compared with the rest of the same year, with one panel per year.
   - 2024: Fennick −79.7%, Ivelholm −77.8% and Brackwater −63.8%. The other seven ports range from −18.9% to +25.8%.
   - 2023: ports range from −26.7% to +33.9%.
3. **`q2_dip_by_carrier_type`**: the same comparison for the three carrier types.
   - 2024: tanker −44.3%, container −28.5%, bulk −6.1%.
   - In actual shipments per month, containers lost the most (8.8, against 3.4 for tankers).

I split the dip views by year because the dip shows up only in 2024. Pooling both years would make it look about half as large as it is.

The facts cells give the numbers only and don't say whether each outcome was met. Tell me what you make of each view and I'll add your verdict in your words.

@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    ## Shipments per month

    **Hypothesis.** Shipments dip in the second quarter.
    **Outcome:** April to June have fewer shipments than the other months of the same year.
    """)
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def shipments_per_month(mo, pl, shipments):
    import altair as alt

    _monthly = (
        shipments
        .group_by(pl.col('ship_date').dt.truncate('1mo').alias('month'))
        .agg(pl.len().alias('shipments'))
        .sort('month')
        .collect()
    )
    shipments_per_month_chart = mo.ui.altair_chart(
        alt.Chart(_monthly)
        .mark_line(point=True)
        .encode(
            x=alt.X('month:T', title='Month'),
            y=alt.Y('shipments:Q', title='Shipments', scale=alt.Scale(zero=True)),
            tooltip=['month:T', 'shipments:Q'],
        )
        .properties(width='container', height=300)
    )
    shipments_per_month_chart
    return (alt,)


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    **Facts.** 1,199 shipments over 24 months (Jan 2023 to Dec 2024), 35 to 60 per month.

    - 2023: April to June had 54, 55, 50. The other months had 41 to 60.
    - 2024: April to June had 35, 41, 39. The other months had 43 to 59.
    - The lowest month is April 2024 (35).
    """)
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    ## Second-quarter dip by port

    **Hypothesis.** A few ports cause most of the second-quarter dip.
    **Outcome:** Two or three ports show a much larger drop in shipments per month in Q2 than the rest of the ports.
    """)
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def q2_dip_by_port(alt, mo, pl, shipments):
    _dip = (
        shipments
        .with_columns(
            pl.col('ship_date').dt.year().alias('year'),
            pl.col('ship_date').dt.quarter().eq(2).alias('in_q2'),
        )
        .group_by('port', 'year')
        .agg(
            pl.col('in_q2').sum().truediv(3).alias('q2_per_month'),
            pl.col('in_q2').not_().sum().truediv(9).alias('rest_per_month'),
        )
        .with_columns(
            pl.col('q2_per_month').truediv(pl.col('rest_per_month')).sub(1).alias('q2_change'),
        )
        .sort('port', 'year')
        .collect()
    )
    q2_dip_by_port_chart = mo.ui.altair_chart(
        alt.Chart(_dip)
        .mark_bar()
        .encode(
            x=alt.X('q2_change:Q', title='Q2 shipments per month vs rest of year', axis=alt.Axis(format='%')),
            y=alt.Y('port:N', title='Port', sort=alt.EncodingSortField('q2_change', order='ascending')),
            color=alt.condition(alt.datum.q2_change < 0, alt.value('#c0504d'), alt.value('#4f81bd')),
            column=alt.Column('year:O', title='Year'),
            tooltip=[
                'port:N',
                'year:O',
                alt.Tooltip('q2_per_month:Q', format='.1f'),
                alt.Tooltip('rest_per_month:Q', format='.1f'),
                alt.Tooltip('q2_change:Q', format='.1%'),
            ],
        )
        .properties(width=280, height=300)
    )
    q2_dip_by_port_chart
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    **Facts.** Q2 shipments per month compared with the other nine months of the same year, for each of 10 ports.

    - 2023: changes range from −26.7% (Dovesend) to +33.9% (Aldermouth). 5 ports are below zero.
    - 2024: Fennick −79.7% (1.3 vs 6.6 per month), Ivelholm −77.8% (1.3 vs 6.0), Brackwater −63.8% (2.3 vs 6.4).
    - 2024, the other 7 ports: −18.9% (Emberly Quay) to +25.8% (Juniper Reach).
    """)
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    ## Second-quarter dip by carrier type

    **Hypothesis.** The second-quarter dip comes from one carrier type.
    **Outcome:** One carrier type shows a much larger drop in shipments per month in Q2 than the others.
    """)
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def q2_dip_by_carrier_type(alt, mo, pl, shipments):
    _dip = (
        shipments
        .with_columns(
            pl.col('ship_date').dt.year().alias('year'),
            pl.col('ship_date').dt.quarter().eq(2).alias('in_q2'),
        )
        .group_by('carrier_type', 'year')
        .agg(
            pl.col('in_q2').sum().truediv(3).alias('q2_per_month'),
            pl.col('in_q2').not_().sum().truediv(9).alias('rest_per_month'),
        )
        .with_columns(
            pl.col('q2_per_month').truediv(pl.col('rest_per_month')).sub(1).alias('q2_change'),
        )
        .sort('carrier_type', 'year')
        .collect()
    )
    q2_dip_by_carrier_type_chart = mo.ui.altair_chart(
        alt.Chart(_dip)
        .mark_bar()
        .encode(
            x=alt.X('q2_change:Q', title='Q2 shipments per month vs rest of year', axis=alt.Axis(format='%')),
            y=alt.Y('carrier_type:N', title='Carrier type', sort=alt.EncodingSortField('q2_change', order='ascending')),
            color=alt.condition(alt.datum.q2_change < 0, alt.value('#c0504d'), alt.value('#4f81bd')),
            column=alt.Column('year:O', title='Year'),
            tooltip=[
                'carrier_type:N',
                'year:O',
                alt.Tooltip('q2_per_month:Q', format='.1f'),
                alt.Tooltip('rest_per_month:Q', format='.1f'),
                alt.Tooltip('q2_change:Q', format='.1%'),
            ],
        )
        .properties(width=280, height=150)
    )
    q2_dip_by_carrier_type_chart
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    **Facts.** Q2 shipments per month compared with the other nine months of the same year, for each of 3 carrier types.

    - 2023: bulk −1.5%, container +1.5%, tanker +21.1%.
    - 2024: tanker −44.3% (4.3 vs 7.8 per month), container −28.5% (22.0 vs 30.8), bulk −6.1% (12.0 vs 12.8).
    - 2024, in absolute terms: container lost 8.8 shipments per month, tanker 3.4 and bulk 0.8.
    """)
    return
